Construct reference-only branch truth by pruning and contraction

reference_truth.Rd

Algorithm S3 restricts a reference tree to retained-taxon sets by graph pruning and contraction while carrying complete original-edge memberships. It accepts no empirical gene trees and does not infer recovery. align_branches() remains the default split-based mapping entry.

Usage

reference_truth(species_tree, retained_taxa, gene_ids = NULL,
  tree_semantics = c("unrooted", "rooted"),
  fusion_view = c("whole", "direct"))

Arguments

species_tree

Reference Newick text/file or one ape::phylo object. At least two distinct reference taxa are required. Every internal node in the original input, including its root, must have at least two children. Non-root branch lengths provide expected values; a display-root length is ignored.

retained_taxa

One character vector, or a list of character vectors of retained reference labels. List names supply optional row identifiers. Each set must contain unique, nonmissing reference labels. Empty sets are allowed.

gene_ids

Optional unique row identifiers, one per retained-taxon set.

tree_semantics

"unrooted" (default) or "rooted". Rooted truth preserves the original root and its path to the retained-tip MRCA. That root is never promoted or suppressed. With one retained taxon, the original root-to-tip path remains. Empty sets have no edges; unrooted sets of one taxon also have no surviving edges.

fusion_view

"whole" constructs expected shared-column values from complete current reference components. "direct" retains only active fused edges.

Value

A splitaligner_truth_result list with a primitive-only state_matrix (observed, NA_struct, NA_fuse), numeric original_matrix, separate fusion_matrix, coordinate tables, component_ledger, fusion_ledger, reference_provenance, metadata and input. Component expected_value and expected_status refer only to reference lengths. reference_source_nodes are zero-based incoming-edge addresses in the input reference Newick, used only for provenance. The fusion ledger records reference representability, expected-value status, construction mode and contributing reference components; it contains no empirical recovery status.

Details

The rooted S3 original-root convention also defines the reference layer of align_fixed_topology. S4 records only the measurements actually represented by its gene input, without changing this reference truth.

observed denotes a separately represented original reference branch, not an empirical observation. Expected component lengths require every contributing reference length to be finite. Missing lengths never change structural identity and are never skipped in a partial sum. Zero, negative lengths and failure markers follow the package's existing numeric policy. No NA_topo or NA_fuse_topo classification occurs in this layer.

Examples

truth <- reference_truth("((A:1,B:2):3,C:4);",
  list(full = c("A", "B", "C"), without_C = c("A", "B"), only_A = "A"),
  tree_semantics = "rooted")
truth$state_matrix
#>           B1         B2          B3          B4        
#> full      "observed" "observed"  "observed"  "observed"
#> without_C "observed" "observed"  "NA_struct" "observed"
#> only_A    "NA_fuse"  "NA_struct" "NA_struct" "NA_fuse" 
truth$original_matrix
#>           B1 B2 B3 B4
#> full       1  2  4  3
#> without_C  1  2 NA  3
#> only_A    NA NA NA NA
truth$fusion_matrix
#>           F[B1|B4]
#> full             4
#> without_C        4
#> only_A           4
